card.name: Inside surnames in citation author lists
card.fires_on: Partway through an unusual surname in a reference or author list, just before the name ends and initials follow. Seen in citations such as 'Pear<<row>> MJ' and 'McCle<<lland>> K'.

modes.label: Surname endings in references
modes.description: The last piece of a split-up surname in a list of citation authors, right before initials or a comma.
modes.example: Redcay E, Dodell-Feder D, Pear<<row>> MJ, Mavros PL, Kle

modes.label: Other names and codes
modes.description: Partway through capitalized brand names or ID strings, less often.
modes.example: TAL<<UX>> treatment. [ see Use in Specific Pop
